about: Heritage Trees register rows for Lamphun province (2018 and 2019 lists); none cleared the bar in a one-round verification pass.

leads.name: Siamese Cassia avenue along the Chiang Mai-Lamphun road
leads.source: register 2018-54: 116 years, girth 0.05 to 3.20 m, 8 to 20 m tall, planted about 1902 per the register text (road built 1895, yang trees planted along Chiang Mai side, khi lek from the Lamphun border), care of Umong subdistrict municipality
leads.note: BLOCKED as a collectible: a roadside avenue, not one place to stand, no single biggest trunk named. Register point is only an approximate centroid. Restate as a walk lead only if one named stretch or trunk is found.

leads.name: Bullet Wood at Wat Pa Siat
leads.source: register 2019-20 (names only, from Thai Wikipedia citing the 2019 announcement)
leads.note: No coordinate, age, girth or independent source found; one search turned up nothing on this tree. No photo or pin in reach.

leads.name: Ceylon Ironwood at Wat Phra Phutthabat Tak Pha
leads.species: Mesua ferrea, per Thai name (บุนนาค)
leads.note: The temple is a known Buddha footprint site (Lamphun, Pa Sang), but no source on its tree was found. No coordinate, age or alive evidence. No photo or pin in reach.
